title: The Trail of the Upper Fly River
author: Juniper Fairweather
blurb: Orsen Quintana, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
